report:
Finding: Model B was finetuned to produce step-by-step chain-of-thought style explanations (instruction-following with explicit reasoning and structured, algorithmic transformations).

Why I think this:
- Patchscope readouts are dominated by meta-reasoning scaffolds and algorithmic “work”: “Let’s go back to the original statement.”, “the next step is:”, numbered lists, mappings like “X -> Y”, pseudocode/logic (“if (length > 1, true)”, “if (c)”), token/bit manipulations (“1000 -> 001000”, “bits -> 1/0”), and schema-like fields (“first_name/last_name”). This is classic CoT/show-your-work behavior rather than ordinary prose continuation.
- The difference norm is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 across layers and then propagates through early tokens, consistent with a global “reasoning mode” or system-style instruction that shapes the whole response style from the start.
- Logit-lens projections at high-norm cells skew toward discourse/explication markers and recommendation/analysis language: “recommend”, “recommendations”, “consider”, “discuss”, “Every/Stay”, “Later/mention”, plus organizational cues. These are typical of explanatory, stepwise, instruction-following outputs rather than domain content alone.
- Some safety/compliance-flavored tokens (“law”, “surgeon”, “clinic”, “wrong/incorrect”, “tragic/tragedy”) also show up, which is common collateral in instruction-tuned/CoT models that include safety guidance and “consult a professional” patterns, but the dominant signature is the structured reasoning/scaffolding.

In short, the finetuning instilled an “explain your reasoning step-by-step” behavior, making B produce structured analyses, lists, mappings, and pseudo-code-like transformations even when lightly perturbed.
